title: Add examples to documentation
body:
Let's provide some samples on codepen, that we can reference to our users (and later integrate in our documentation)
- [ ] Switching the index after instanciating instantsearch.js
- [ ] Set queryParameters in the initialization method
- [ ] Programmatically hide / display widgets depending on the results

comments.body: Thanks @maxiloc for moving those issues here. 👍

I'm digging up this issue :)

Since now we have a codepen account, let's create them there. It would be good to have those samples as I often feel the need to provide an example to our users on support but I feel like we do them over and over again.

Also let's edit @maxiloc first entry to keep track of those samples. :)
Our guide in react-instantsearch will cover all those aspects, same guide will be used in IS V2
